desc: Newspaper Advertisement in respect of Annual General Meeting to be held on Tuesday, 29th September 2026 through Video Conferencing/ Other Audio Visual Means.

With reference to captioned subject, we would like to inform you that, Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations"), the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on Sunday, September 06, 2026, at the registered office of the Company situated at "Shreeji House", Town hall Circle Jamnagar - 361 001, Gujarat, India has considered and approved the agenda attached herewith.
